checkpoint_tie_break: higher macro character F1 (4-type average), then earlier declared checkpoint
note: Corrected successor to configs/calibration.json (2026-11-01): detection F1 ('any') is now the primary checkpoint-selection key and macro F1 only the secondary tie-break, so a checkpoint cannot win by a macro gain that regresses detection F1. configs/calibration.json is left untouched because its SHA-256 is pinned in docs/FINAL_PROTOCOL.json as provenance for the already-frozen, already-tested decision; this file is for any new, not-yet-frozen calibration run.
